thread:
Clare: Heads-up — all-hands starts in 20. Quick ops note: primary stream via Zoom -> OBS -> YouTube. If Zoom recording fails we fallback to Loom (local recorder). Jamal will do stage hand-off for Q&A. Please drop live questions in #all-hands-questions and pin any that need leadership follow-up.

Jamal: I can take stage handoff. Two asks: 1) can we enable closed captions? Zoom captions are hit-or-miss. 2) Slides should stay in presenter view so we can see notes.

Ana: +1 captions. If Zoom captions are flaky, can we let YouTube auto-caption as a backup? Also reminder: set mic sensitivity to -6dB so room noise doesn't gate.

Zoe: Will prep a one-slide script for the leadership Q&A handoff (names + 2 bullets each). Also can someone add the pinned Q&A doc link?

DevOps Bot: OBS RTMP to primary: rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2/<key> — fallback to Loom local recording if RTMP fails. Will post events to #all-hands-ops.

Matt: I'll watch the caption stream and check latency. If captions drop, I'll trigger the RTMP retry and post the new ingest URL here.

Jamal: Quick technical: OBS scene needs a browser source for the caption overlay. Copy-paste this CSS to ensure readability: `#captions { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); padding: 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 20px; }`

Clare: Thanks. Two logistical notes: 1) if recording is stopped, Ops will still keep the live stream up for 10 mins while we migrate. 2) Leadership Q&A starts 15 minutes into the meeting; please be ready to surface follow-ups in the doc.

Zoe: Pinned the Q&A doc: https://docs.internal/all-hands/2026-q2-qa — put follow-ups there, tag the person responsible.

DevOps Bot: Recording started — https://storage.internal/recordings/1978889990.mp4 :record_button:

Ana: Small ask for presenters: enable "show speaker notes" in presenter view and upload final slides to the shared folder now.

Jamal: Roger that. I'll cue leaders at T+14 and hand to Clare for closing. :thumbsup:
